title: Red and blue effects on physiological arousal
statement:
Red increases physiological arousal (heart rate, blood pressure) while blue decreases it, providing a basis for calming versus stimulating interface choices.

Options:
- Calming blue: #0000FF pure blue (fits: patient portal, banking login)
- Arousing red: #FF0000 pure red (fits: alert, high intensity)
- Agreeable green: #00FF00 green (fits: success, healing)
- Stimulating yellow: #FFFF00 yellow (fits: attention, caution)
appliesWhen: Applies to: health, fintech. Audience: adults, seniors, general.
